optimizer: AdamW, 2 param groups: backbone (backbone_lr), head (lr); stage 1 (epochs 1..freeze_epochs): backbone frozen with BatchNorm in eval mode, only the head trains
scheduler: stage 1: constant lr; stage 2: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=epochs - freeze_epochs) on both groups, stepped per epoch
early_stopping: validation macro-F1, counted from epoch 1, may stop the run only in stage 2
